description: Asterinas vs vendor Linux 6.6.87 on the same Megrez board, same Debian rootfs, same static-musl benchmarks. Ratio = Asterinas / Linux; below 1 means Asterinas is faster.

linux.kernel: 6.6.87-win2030-origin (vendor RockOS kernel), root mounted read-only, initramfs + chroot into the shared rootfs

notes: io4k is a 4 KiB random read/write loop over a 64 MiB tmpfs file (bs=4k, iodepth=1), the fio parameter set without the fio binary: installing fio triggered an eMMC multi-block write failure on this board.
Linux numbers were taken with init=/bin/sh inside the vendor initramfs plus a chroot into the read-only rootfs, so no filesystem writes happened on the Linux side.
io4k read IOPS vary between runs (26.7k-39.3k on Asterinas), so its gate carries that headroom.
